channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Indicted Defendant In Somali Fraud Scandal Still Getting Millions From Minnesota, Says GOP Lawmaker
item.description: Individuals connected to the Minnesota's largest fraud scandal, including a defendant awaiting trial, are still receiving millions in taxpayer funds, says a Republican in the state.

item.title: Over $9 Billion Looted From Minnesota Medicaid Programs, Feds Say
item.description: Federal prosecutors alleged Thursday that Minnesota may have lost billions of dollars to fraud in its Medicaid program, the latest development in an ongoing investigation.

item.title: Handful Of House Democrats Embrace Deregulation As America’s Grid Stares Down Disaster
item.description: The House passed a bipartisan deregulation bill known as the SPEED Act on Thursday, with just shy of a dozen Democrats supporting the measure amid America's rising energy demand.

item.title: Only Four Democrats Vote To Stop Taxpayer Funding Of Child Sex Changes In Medicaid
item.description: Four House Democrats joined Republicans to pass a bill halting federal Medicaid funding of sex change surgeries and medications for minors on Thursday.

item.title: Joy Behar Blasts Trump Over Obama, Biden Plaques
Struggling American Workers Call ‘Bullsh*t’ On Democrats’ Bid To Keep H1-B Tap Flowing
item.description: American workers struggling to find employment in the tech industry are ripping Democrats for protecting the massive flow of cheap, foreign labor into the country.

item.title: Russell Brand Slams Katy Perry’s Romance With Justin Trudeau: ‘Don’t Put Me In a Category With That Guy’
item.description: "I was okay with Orlando Bloom, but Justin Trudeau? Come on, man!"

item.title: KEVIN FRAZIER: Trump AI Executive Order Protects Americans From Tower Of Babel Approach
item.description: The answer to two questions will shape the future of AI in the United States: Who gets to write the national rules for AI development? Who gets to write the rules for how AI is adopted at the state level?

item.title: Birthday Trip Ends in Horror: Moments Before Deadly Crash, Cristina Biffle Sent Chilling Text
item.description: They were headed south on what Cristina’s mother described as a “birthday trip,” a chance for the family to celebrate and unwind.

item.title: JFK’s Grandson Blasts Vote To Add Trump’s Name To Kennedy Center, Says Board Was Silenced
item.description: “Microphones were muted and the board meeting and vote NOT unanimous."
